name: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities

angles.text: As a mage, you have a natural interest in arcane study. Recovering magical treatises and contributing to scholarly libraries suit your craft.
As a dwarf, you know the value of written records, artifacts, and obscure lore. Dwarven scholars and the Explorers' League prize them.

faq.answer: Ataeric seeks magical writings to add to a library's collection of arcane lore.
faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?

faq.answer: Ataeric wrote the treatise. A researcher or curator gathers magical works and rare volumes for a library's archives.
The curiosities are sought for an academic collection at a scholarly library.
faq.q: Which library benefits from these curiosities?

faq.answer: Yes. The scholar welcomes any further magical works found during your travels to broaden the library's lore.
faq.q: Are there more magical works to collect?

faq.answer: The library seeks rare treatises to deepen the study of the arcane and preserve mystical knowledge.
faq.q: Why does the library seek arcane curiosities?

faq.answer: Recovering arcane works brings obscure knowledge into a library where it can be kept and studied instead of remaining lost in the field.
faq.q: Why is recovering arcane works important?

sections.body: Across Azeroth, scholars rely on travelers to recover rare tomes and treatises from dangerous ground. Ataeric seeks magical writings to broaden an institution's study of the arcane. Each volume can help scholars piece together practices that might otherwise be scattered or lost.
sections.title: Preserving Arcane Knowledge

sections.body: The curator adds each curiosity to the archive. The library remains eager for further magical writings found across the world, so its collection can grow with ongoing scholarship.
sections.title: An Expanding Archive

summary: Ataeric seeks rare magical writings to enlarge a library's collection. Scholars hope these works will deepen their study of the arcane and keep its lore safe.
attribution: In-game quest text: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities
